next_step: Run 72h soak test on 4xA100 pool; finalize SLA targets; legal review of DPA
notes:
POC focused on Redwood Dedicated capacity and predictable SLOs. Primary ask: throughput guarantees during market-hour spikes and consistent p95 latency for short-chat and long-context summarization. Initial POC config: 4x A100 (80GB) reserved pool for load/soak tests; target production sizing discussed: 8x H100 for 24/7 peak handling.

Performance targets (customer stated): p95 <= 150ms for ~64-token replies; p95 <= 300ms for 512-token responses under steady-state; steady-state throughput target 300-500 req/s with occasional bursts to 900 req/s for short windows. Token budget estimate ~3M tokens/day in steady-state.

Test plan highlights:
- Load tests: ramp to 900 rps over 30m, sustained at 500 rps for 2h, monitor p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, GPU util.
- Soak test: 72-hour continuous run at 300 rps to surface memory leaks, KV cache eviction patterns, and degraded tail latencies.
- Representative prompts: (1) short conversational intent (10-40 tokens), (2) contract summarization (input ~8k tokens, output ~200 tokens), (3) reranking top-5 candidate model outputs for fraud scoring.
- Cache scenarios: warm cache vs cold cache runs to quantify prefix/KV cache benefit and upstream latency for cold misses.
- Fallback verification: simulate Dedicated->Hosted fallback under drain to validate no request loss and latency impact.

SLA negotiation points: 99.95% uptime target for Dedicated service, crediting mechanism for degraded p95 tail, on-call escalation window during market hours, egress and long-retention pricing. Security/legal: customer requires DPA + SOC2 details, KMS integration, audit-log retention 7 years for some subsystems, and optional data residency in us-east-1.

Quote from VP Engineering: "Need predictability under market hours spikes — if latency jumps we lose downstream trading signals."

Current status: security questionnaire sent (drive link), benchmarking env provisioned, first load test run scheduled 2026-03-12, soak test kickoff pending security signoff. Expected procurement decision conditional on soak results and final SLA terms.
